integrity: Analytical proof of the stated finite-n Gaussian optimal-design theorem with reproducible independent numerical checks. Source precedence remains qualified and no independent mathematical review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Known stationary exponential covariance, one spatial dimension, independent Gaussian observations with a continuously divisible precision budget and a fixed finite sensor count. It does not cover adaptive designs, unequal acquisition costs, integer replication constraints, unknown covariance or other kernels. Older integral-estimation work may require further publication-priority review.
title: Globally optimal precision budgets and observation meshes for Ornstein–Uhlenbeck Bayesian quadrature
